text:
nina (events): Heads up: were doing a virtual lobby format next Wed. Need owners for reg page, Zoom lobby flow, captioning, and post-event asset list. Quick call?

leo (producer): Ill own capture + clips. Need stream key for OBS fallback and confirmation about local capture policy.

maya (growth): Ill own post-event cadence & HubSpot mapping. Reg page fields: first, last, email, company, role, timezone. Add recording consent checkbox.

 tom (product): Ill build reg template and add hidden utm params. Also include a short multi-choice field: interest area (genai, embeddings, cost, infra).

nina (events): Zoom plan: enable cloud recording + auto-transcript; require registration (auto-approve); enable waiting room for 10m pre-show; set chat to host-only during live; disable file transfer. Alternative host: leo.

leo (producer): Local backup on SSD + Auto upload to S3 after event. Naming: `lobby_{YYYYMMDD}_{region}_{raw,edited}.{ext}`. Ill also produce a 30s teaser for social within 24h.

maya (growth): Post-event flows: Day0 replay email + calendar attach, Day2 highlights clip + case study CTA, Day7 full replay + transcript. HubSpot tags: source=webinar, campaign=lobby-april, consent_field mapped.

 tom (product): Add a consent flag in the registration payload so Zapier can filter non-consent and mark them private.

nina (events): Ops checklist Ill pin: 1) Reg page live + test, 2) Meeting created + alt hosts, 3) Producer backup ok, 4) Zapier mapping posted, 5) Pre-show run at T-30.

leo (producer): Accessibility: Ill generate .vtt captions and a plain-text transcript. If any attendee asks to not be recorded, well scrub their chat/messages before publishing.

maya (growth): Social needs: 30s landscape + 15s vertical. Leo can we also get a lower-third-safe 15s for paid?

leo (producer): Yes. Ill output all three and drop to `s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/lobby-2026/`.

zoom-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Redwood Virtual Lobby: April" Wed 2026-04-14 18:00 UTC. Recording: enabled.
